name: Data hover Filter
description: A text-format filter that copies each link's text into a data-hover attribute on the <a> tag.
project_description: Data hover Filter ships a single text-format filter (plugin id filter_attribute) that, when enabled on a text format, walks the rendered HTML and adds a data-hover attribute to every <a> tag whose value is the link's own text. This lets themes and CSS build hover/tooltip effects driven by the link label (for example duplicating the label in a ::before pseudo-element) without editors having to add the attribute by hand. The module has no configuration, no permissions of its own, and no dependencies beyond core's Filter module.
